name.en: Sword Forge Manor · The Leather-Jacket Grandmaster

plain.zh: NVIDIA 設計 AI 最常用的運算晶片（GPU），還有讓工程師寫 GPU 程式的軟體 CUDA。幾乎所有 AI 公司都用它的產品，所以它是這張地圖的中心。
plain.en: NVIDIA designs the chips (GPUs) most AI runs on, plus CUDA, the software engineers use to program them. Nearly every AI company relies on it — so it sits at the center of this map.

story.zh: NVIDIA 1993 年成立，原本做遊戲顯示卡。後來研究人員發現 GPU 能同時做大量計算，非常適合訓練 AI；NVIDIA 在 2006 年推出 CUDA，讓 GPU 能寫一般程式。近二十年累積下來的軟體與開發者，讓別家晶片很難取代它。
story.en: Founded in 1993, NVIDIA began with gaming graphics cards. Researchers found GPUs could run massive parallel math — perfect for AI. CUDA, launched in 2006, let anyone program GPUs, and nearly two decades of software and developers make NVIDIA hard to replace.

leader.imagePrompt: Character: a cheerful cartoon grandmaster blacksmith with short silver-white hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a black top and wuxia robes, presenting a glowing green sword forged from a computer chip with a keynote-style open-hand gesture, green stage light and a giant forge behind, original chibi face that does not resemble any real person. Accent color: NVIDIA green #76B900. Mood: confident.

plain.zh: Amazon、Google、Microsoft 這類雲端大廠。他們買下最多 GPU，蓋成巨大的資料中心，再按用量把算力租給全世界，同時也開始自己設計 AI 晶片。
plain.en: Cloud giants like Amazon, Google and Microsoft. They buy the most GPUs, build vast data centers, rent compute to the world by usage — and increasingly design their own AI chips.

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a grand mountain temple whose halls are filled with rows of glowing server racks shaped like incense towers, monks carrying glowing chips, golden roofs in mist. Accent color: golden yellow. Mood: majestic.

real.zh: AI Labs（頂尖 AI 實驗室）

plain.zh: 開發最先進 AI 模型的頂尖實驗室，像 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind。訓練一個頂級模型可能要上萬顆 GPU、花費數十億美元。
plain.en: The labs building the most advanced AI models — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind. Training a frontier model can take tens of thousands of GPUs and billions of dollars.

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a misty mountain summit arena with five stone platforms, glowing purple sword trails crossing in the sky, a friendly sparring match atmosphere. Accent color: purple. Mood: epic.

plain.zh: 從第一天就以 AI 為核心的新創公司。投影片寫「10K+」，代表全世界有上萬家；這裡列出的是投影片點名的代表。
plain.en: Startups built around AI from day one. The slide says 10K+ — more than ten thousand worldwide; these are the ones it names.

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a bustling market town at the foot of a mountain, many young cheerful swordsmen with orange sashes practicing different moves, lanterns and banners without text. Accent color: orange. Mood: energetic.

plain.zh: 專門出租 GPU 的新型雲端業者。不像大雲端什麼都賣，他們專注把最新 GPU 快速租給 AI 公司。
plain.en: New-breed clouds that specialize in renting GPUs. Unlike the giants, they focus on getting the newest GPUs to AI companies fast.

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a lively weapon shop street with racks of glowing teal swords and blank wooden rental tags, merchants waving customers in. Accent color: teal. Mood: welcoming.

plain.zh: 把 NVIDIA 晶片組裝成伺服器和整櫃系統的廠商。很多是台灣公司，是 AI 供應鏈不可或缺的一環。
plain.en: The makers who turn NVIDIA chips into servers and full racks — many of them Taiwanese, and indispensable to the AI supply chain.

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a row of busy riverside forges where cheerful smiths hammer server-shaped armor, sparks flying, steel blue banners without text. Accent color: steel blue. Mood: hardworking.

plain.zh: 汽車、醫療、金融、製造等各行各業，把 AI 用在自家業務上。這裡每一張卡代表一個「產業」，並列出代表企業。
plain.en: Autos, healthcare, finance, manufacturing and more, putting AI to work. Each card here is a whole industry, with example companies.

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a panorama of different clan estates — a car workshop, a herbal clinic, a counting house — connected by mountain roads, magenta flags without text. Accent color: magenta. Mood: prosperous.

real.zh: OpenShell 夥伴（AI Agent 安全）

plain.zh: AI Agent 能自己操作電腦、寄信、改資料後，安全就變得很重要。這些夥伴和 NVIDIA 一起支持 OpenShell：讓 AI Agent 在有規則的沙盒裡執行。
plain.en: Once AI agents can operate computers, send email and change data, safety becomes critical. These partners back NVIDIA OpenShell, which runs agents inside rule-bound sandboxes.

sources.title: NVIDIA Launches Open Agent Safety Platform to Secure Agents From Testing to Deployment (NVIDIA)
NVIDIA Launches Open Agent Safety Platform for AI Agents (Channel Insider)

factions.imagePrompt: Scene: a city gate watched by friendly constables in deep blue uniforms guiding small glowing helper spirits (AI agents) through a protective shimmering shell barrier. Accent color: deep blue. Mood: reassuring.
factions.slideTitle: Over 100 Partners Advance Agent Safety with NVIDIA OpenShell
